title: Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) & Rupee Cost Averaging
content: A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) enables automated periodic investments (monthly/quarterly) into mutual funds. SIP benefits include: 1. Rupee Cost Averaging: Buying more units when market prices drop and fewer units when prices rise, lowering the average cost per unit without timing the market. 2. Financial Discipline: Regular automated savings build long-term compounding wealth. 3. Low Barrier to Entry: Allows starting with as low as ₹500 per month.
